description: This file contains unit tests for the 'tool-policy' module, specifically testing functions analyzeAllowlistByToolType and buildPluginToolGroups. It verifies behavior when handling allowlists with plugin tools, core tools, and unknown entries, and tests plugin group building logic.

methods.name: analyzeAllowlistByToolType
methods.description: Analyzes an allowlist object to determine if it only targets plugin tools, and identifies unknown entries based on provided plugin groups and core tools.

methods.name: buildPluginToolGroups
methods.description: Constructs a structure grouping plugin tools based on provided tool metadata.

ctags.name: emptyPlugins
ctags.pattern: /^    const emptyPlugins: PluginToolGroups = { all: [], byPlugin: new Map() };$/

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = analyzeAllowlistByToolType({ allow: ["*"] }, pluginGroups, coreTools);$/

ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = analyzeAllowlistByToolType({ allow: ["apply_patch"] }, pluginGroups, coreTool/

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = analyzeAllowlistByToolType({ allow: ["lobster"] }, emptyPlugins, coreTools);$/
